subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the msteams plugin add a Copilot-specific streaming override, and which Copilot activity detector plus config key shape should become the canonical contract?
rationale: The source limitation is clear, but the permanent API expands channel config and depends on Microsoft 365 Copilot activity metadata that has not been proven in-repo.

options.title: Approve after live metadata proof
options.body: Keep this issue open, require a redacted Copilot custom-engine activity sample, then implement the approved detector and config shape inside the msteams plugin.

options.title: Keep global-only streaming
options.body: Do not add a per-surface override and document that operators must choose one global Teams streaming mode for both DMs and Copilot.

options.title: Defer to broader Teams roadmap
options.body: Leave this tracked under the Microsoft channel backlog until maintainers choose a broader Teams surface taxonomy for Copilot, DMs, groups, and channels.

recommendation.title: Approve after live metadata proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, require a redacted Copilot custom-engine activity sample, then implement the approved detector and config shape inside the msteams plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux has adjacent msteams config history and owns the open Microsoft ecosystem tracker that includes this item.
